curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: re-use empty containers of different capacities to keep items.

mission.title: re-use empty containers of different capacities to keep items.

interactions.prompt: A clean empty yoghurt cup can be useful again. What can it hold?
interactions.feedback: Yes! A clean empty cup can keep pencils together.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the safe school item that fits in a small cup.

interactions.prompt: Watch: a large clean tin keeps many bottle tops. Which container is best for many bottle tops?

model.reason: Many small things need a larger container.

interactions.feedback: Good thinking! The larger tin has room for many bottle tops.
interactions.retryHint: Think: which container has more room?

interactions.prompt: Match each clean empty container to what it can keep. Tap a container, then tap its item.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a container and then tap the item it can keep.
interactions.feedback: Great matches! Small and large containers can both be reused usefully.
interactions.retryHint: Match the few crayons to the small cup. Match many blocks to the large box.

interactions.prompt: Nia has a clean empty plastic bottle. What is a safe way to reuse it at home?
choices: Use it for hot cooking oil
interactions.feedback: Correct! A clean bottle can keep dried beans safely with an adult's help.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the safe way to keep a dry item at home.

interactions.prompt: Help tidy the class. Put the items in the best reused container. Tap the item, then its container.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an item and then tap the reused container with enough room.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Reusing containers helps keep our class neat.
interactions.retryHint: A few small seeds fit in the jar. Many paper scraps need the box.

interactions.prompt: Why do we reuse clean empty containers?
choices: They help us keep things safely and reduce waste.
interactions.answer: They help us keep things safely and reduce waste.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Reusing safe clean containers keeps items tidy and cares for our environment.
interactions.retryHint: Think about keeping things tidy and making less waste.
